items.text: Panthalkudi canal overflow: immediate risk. Evacuate low-lying homes near Sellur tank and canal banks. Call 1077.
items.source: New Indian Express Jul 2026; The Hindu Oct 2026

items.text: Panthalkudi canal is blocked by debris and sewage. Parts of Sellur are most affected. Report canal blockage to Corporation helpline 1077 immediately.
Stormwater drains blocked by uncollected garbage. Report to 1077 with exact street name. Do not attempt to clear drains yourself during rain.
SS Colony, Surveyor Colony, and Kalavasal are waste-vulnerable zones. Garbage washes into drains during rain. Report accumulation to 1077.
Waterlogging expected in 50 identified vulnerable spots. Corporation has motor pumps ready. Report water stagnation with location to 1077.
New road slopes in Sellur and Arapalayam do not drain properly into Vaigai. Flooding lasts 3-4 hours after rainfall. Avoid these routes during rain.
If water enters your home, move to higher floor immediately. Nearest relief camp listed by zone. Call 1077 for evacuation assistance.
Relief camps equipped with food, drinking water, medical care. Temporary shelters ready in Mattuthavani, Sellur, Villapuram, Arapalayam.
Madurai has lost sponge capacity due to urbanisation. Rainwater has nowhere to go. Report groundwater depletion and recharge pit opportunities separately.
If you see cracks in embankment, canal wall, or bridge, report to 1077 immediately. Do not cross flooded roads or bridges.
Corporation deploys motor pumps to clear waterlogging in low-lying areas. Report stagnant water with exact location for pump deployment.
Toll-free helpline 1077 for rain-related emergencies and grievances. Emergency control room operates 24/7 at District Collectorate.
Call 108 for medical emergency during flood: drowning, injury, chest pain, unconscious person.
Mullaperiyar and Vaigai reservoir levels are low. Drinking water supply under watch. Conserve water even during flood season.
